runs.text: Write the core of the kiosk, without files: start with the initial stock, read the sales, code and amount, until a 0, and check each one with the rules of Part II. At the end show the total, the total with discount and
with the final inventory in JSON, as in the lesson.
The JSON text of the inventory is built by a pure function,
, which receives the list of products.

hints.text: Go back to your card and your plan: which steps belong to the core?
It is the till with stock of Part II; only the closing changes.
walks through the products and joins each pair with commas, between braces, like the inventory of lesson 6.2.
The first entry carries no comma before it: check whether the text is still only the brace. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Add to the closing how many sales were rejected.

Hidden cases: an invalid sale in the middle, a sale that leaves a stock at 0, one that asks for more than there is, the five products, large amounts rejected, a day with only rejections and an amount of 0. The keys of the JSON are the names of the catalogue, with a capital letter and an accent.
